body:
Duplicate of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/96737

Thank you for the report. I am closing this as a duplicate of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/96737 so that we can track the issue in one place. Please provide further info as a response to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/96737

The underlying cause and solution are the same. Right now Godot only uses the `TEXTURE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT` when we need it internally. Whether it is needed is a factor of several things (one of them being whether the Mobile or Forward+ backend is used). Regardless of _why_ the texture was created without the bit, we need to make it so that you can request the bit if you need it.
